# alert-provider
Observability plumbing (krateo-platformops): a firing Alert -> Incidents
(observability.krateo.io/v1alpha1, incident-controller's CRD), one per problem, each with an
incident-agent A2A root-cause analysis. It calls agents; it is not one.
Identity: one Alert CR = one HyperDX alert named after its metadata.name; its incidents carry the
label observability.krateo.io/alert=<metadata.name>.
Firing: each reconciler pass (60 s) that mirrors an Alert's HyperDX state as ALERT. The webhook
only logs.
Opening: autopilot (config.compareA2aUrl) compares the firing with each open analyzed incident,
newest first; the first judged equal gets firings++. Else an open incident with no analysis
(Analyzing, or its RCA failed) gets it; else a Resolved incident within one spec.interval of
resolution.at (grace; never after Closed); else, if a comparison gave no verdict (failed, 429,
no {"equal": bool} block), nothing; else a new <alert>-<yyyymmdd-hhmmss> opens (Analyzing -> RCA
-> Open, error set when it has no howToFix).
compare.py: the comparison prompt + verdict parser; header X-Krateo-Purpose: incident-compare,
which agentgateway-policies' incidentCompare route rate-limits.

docs/overview.md: architecture
docs/usage.md: install + wire the webhook
docs/configuration.md: image + runtime env
docs/api.md: the Alert CRD, the Incident fields written, HTTP surface
report_v2.py: the RCA output contract; howToFix = {precondition, apply, verify, rollback} bash scripts, exit 0 gone / 1 holds / else unknown, the first three or none, rollback optional
docs/examples.md: runnable examples
docs/release.md: bare-semver build/release
helm/alert-provider/: the chart
Alert.status.okSince: when the alert last turned OK, unset otherwise; display only.
ClusterRole krateo-alert-viewer: get/list/watch on Alerts for portal users (the portal reads with the user's token); shipped with no binding, admins bind it to groups.
